_about: Saved logins on Connections (src/saved-logins.mjs): what a person reads, the limits, and how a pasted export is read. hide_after_seconds is how long a shown value stays on screen. max_sealed_bytes keeps a person's whole locked box (one sealed snapshot, held in one Durable Object row of at most 2 MB) under that row's size. reveals_shown is how many shows each login lists. import.columns maps a CSV header (lower case) to the login's title, site or user name; every other non-empty column becomes one of the login's values, except import.ignored. import.field_words: a toggle in a pasted outline whose name holds one of these words is a value of the login (its child line is the value); any other toggle under a service is a user name whose child line is its password. grant_quote_min_words is the fewest words an AI must quote from the person's own message to turn reading on from it. grant_verified_roads names the roads a message must have been captured by (its captured_road, set by the message store: carrier_door is /inbound, which the transcript hook and other carriers use; signed_in_screen is text typed on the person's page); a message that came in by any other road (record_messages, a rule, a chat import) never counts.

words.heading: Saved logins
words.body: Keep a site's sign-in here instead of a notes page. Each value is locked in your account. You see it after you confirm it is you, and every time it is shown is listed under it.
words.empty_detail: None yet. Save one, or import the logins you keep somewhere else.
words.save_detail: Saving the same site and user name again replaces its values.
words.other_label: Other values, one per line as Name: value
words.import_detail: Paste a CSV export from your password manager or browser, or the text of a page where you keep logins, copied whole.
words.ai_switch: Let my AIs read this login
words.ai_confirm: Your AIs connected to Trillion can then read every value of this login and use it to sign in. Each read is listed here.
words.remove_confirm: Remove {title}? Its values are deleted from your account.
words.reveal_label: {field} for {title}. It hides itself in {seconds} seconds.
words.ai_off: Your AIs can no longer read {title}.
words.ai_on_many: Your AIs can now read {count} logins.
words.ai_off_many: Your AIs can no longer read {count} logins.
words.ai_all: Let my AIs read all my logins
words.ai_all_confirm: Your AIs connected to Trillion can then read every value of all {count} logins and use them to sign in. Each read is listed under its login.
words.ai_these_confirm: Your AIs connected to Trillion can then read every value of the logins you picked and use them to sign in. Each read is listed under its login.
words.nothing_imported: Nothing could be read as a login. Paste a CSV with a header row (such as name, url, username, password), or a page where each service holds its user names and passwords.
words.no_values: Type at least one value to keep, such as the password.
words.no_name: Type the site or app this login is for.
words.not_found: That login is not in your account. It may have been removed.
words.field_not_found: That value is not in this login any more.
words.sign_in_again: For your safety, sign in again first. Opening sign-in…
words.ai_not_allowed: The person has not let their AIs read this login. If they already said their AIs may use their logins, turn it on with let_ais_read_logins and their message; otherwise ask them once.
words.ai_private_only: This sign-in reaches shared pursuits only, so it cannot read saved logins.
words.too_many_fields: A login keeps at most {max} values.
words.box_full: Your account cannot lock away more values: it holds as much as it can. Remove logins you no longer use, then save again.
words.paste_too_long: That paste is longer than {max} characters. Import it in parts.
words.too_many_in_paste: That paste holds more than {max} logins. Import it in parts.
words.ai_granted_all: Your AIs can now read all {count} logins, and any login you keep later, as you said.
words.grant_not_person: That message is not one the person wrote. Name a message of theirs that lets their AIs read their logins.
words.grant_not_captured: That message was written by an AI app, not captured from the person. Only a message the person typed (recorded from their Claude Code or Codex session, or typed on their signed-in page) can let their AIs read their logins.
words.grant_quote_short: Quote at least {min} words from the person's message that let their AIs read their logins.
words.grant_quote_missing: Those words are not in that message. Quote the person's words exactly as they wrote them.
words.ai_grant_line: Your AIs read these because you said: “{quote}” ({when}).
words.ai_stop_all: Stop my AIs reading all my logins
words.ai_stop_all_confirm: Your AIs then can no longer read any of your logins, and logins you keep later stay closed to them until you let them again.
